confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are bounded estimates from search-result snippets of crowd-sourced Numbeo-derived and Expatistan pages with mixed dates (2025 to 2026); I did not open the pages. Cocktail and wine are derived from the local beer price and restaurant bottle markups, not direct quotes. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates with no search, and July is peak-summer pricing for tourist lodging. Beer, coffee and meal prices were converted at roughly 9.3 MAD per USD. The FX observation (15 Oct 2026, 4pm) was read from an RBA search-result snippet, not from a page I opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors rest on Marrakech-specific Numbeo and Expatistan snippets. Cocktail is set at about 1.8 times the beer anchor; wine glass is about one fifth of a typical restaurant bottle price. Accommodation is a model estimate from general knowledge of Marrakech tourist lodging tiers.
